title: Summit
tagline: Four friends. One mountain. No way down but up.
description: A four-player co-op climb from a jungle shoreline to a volcanic caldera. Stamina is everything: every hold you take drains it, every ledge you haul a friend over costs you both. Weather turns, hunger bites, and the route is generated fresh from a seed every run. Rope up, ration the food, and get everyone to the extraction helicopter at the peak.
controls: WASD · Mouse look · Space · Shift · Trackpad friendly
